title: Iceland rejects EU accession talks in referendum after divisive campaign
summary_full: Well-funded no camp prevails, winning 52.8% of votes and gaining plaudits from Eurosceptic figures across EuropeAnalysis: Definitely no or maybe yes: what tipped the Icelandic referendumVoters in Iceland have ⁠rejected ⁠the government’s proposal ​to hold ⁠accession talks with ⁠the ​European Union  after a closely fought campaign that has divided the country.After a long and anxious night for those on both sides of the debate, the no camp ended up with 52.8% of votes and the yes camp with 47.2%. Voter turnout was high at 82.5%.Reuters and Agence France-Presse contributed to this story. Continue reading...
